The '''Goo brothers''' were [[Chortose (species)/Legends|Chortose]] brothers. They operated a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair yard in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. One of the brothers was [[Porgo Goo]].
